_comment: Threshold requirements, New Jersey N.J.A.C. 5:80-33 (2026). The numbered eligibility requirements of 33.12(c) (PDF pp.29-44) at paragraph level, the 65% minimum score in 33.14(a), and two Family Cycle limits from 33.4(a). Not extracted: 33.12(c)11 (CPA itemisation of a prior owner's expenditures), (c)12 (USDA letters), (c)16 (HOPE VI documentation) and (c)21 (right of first refusal), which are documentation or program-specific; and the cycle credit caps and set-aside mechanics of 33.4-33.9.

criteria.heading: Minimum score: 65% of the maximum
criteria.quote: applications that fail to satisfy a minimum of 65 percent of the maximum score
criteria.note: The regulation never states the maximum. On the maxima computed in NJ_2026.json it is about 63 points in the Family Cycle (of 97), 57 in Senior (of 88) and 64 in Supportive Housing (of 98). The Mixed-Income and Emerging Developer set-asides restate the 65% floor and add category minimums (33.4(a)1 and 3).
